mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (ledger_id, account_id, category_id, type, amount, occurred_at, note) VALUES (#{ledgerId}, #{accountId}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{occurredAt}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_id, account_id, category_id, type, amount, occurred_at, note, created_at, updated_at FROM transactions WHERE ledger_id = #{ledgerId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET account_id = #{accountId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, occurred_at = #{occurredAt}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id}
